Collection: every Lore service (lore-api, the stations service and the lore-mcp gateway) serves OpenTelemetry metrics as Prometheus text on a `metrics` port. The port is 9464 by default and can be set with `LORE_METRICS_PORT`. It uses `@opentelemetry/exporter-prometheus`. lore-api passes the Prometheus reader to its NodeSDK and keeps the Cloud Trace exporter for traces. The stations service and the lore-mcp gateway each register their own MeterProvider. The Cloud Monitoring metric exporter was removed. The floor and the ai-agent-subsystem controller keep their own hand-written `/metrics` endpoints.

Instruments live in `libs/shared/src/outbound/otel/metrics.ts`. They are resolved lazily against the MeterProvider registered at record time, and each one is recorded from a single site. The metrics are:
- `lore.station.runs` and `lore.station.duration_ms`
- `lore.bus.deliveries` and `lore.bus.queue_depth`
- `lore.floor.starts`
- `lore.webhook.events`
- `lore.llm.calls`, `lore.llm.tokens` and `lore.llm.cost_usd`
- `lore.billed.cost_usd`, a gauge read from the synced Anthropic and GCP daily tables that `/spend` reads
- `lore.http.requests` and `lore.tool.calls`

Viewing: terraform installs kube-prometheus-stack (Prometheus) and Grafana in a `monitoring` namespace when `enable_monitoring` is set. PodMonitors and ServiceMonitors scrape every service, plus the floor's and the controller's `/metrics`. Grafana is served at grafana.gcp.re-cinq.com behind oauth2-proxy with Google login, the same gate as Headlamp. It has five dashboards. No dashboard names an assembly line: a single per-line board takes its `line` variable from the metric labels. Grafana also reads GKE's own pod metrics from Cloud Monitoring through a datasource. The web UI links to Grafana only when terraform provides `GRAFANA_URL`. Traces still go to Cloud Trace.

judgements.reason: The answer covers every essential point in the gold answer: OpenTelemetry Prometheus text on port 9464, kube-prometheus-stack scraping it when terraform's enable_monitoring is set, Grafana for viewing, and traces to Cloud Trace via lore-api. Nothing in it contradicts the gold answer.
